title: 103 Early Hints: Overlapping Server Think Time
description: Observe how an interim 103 frame starts CSS and font fetches before the 200 OK HTML arrives.

steps.label: 1. Browser Sends Navigation GET
steps.description: Client requests /dashboard. The origin needs 350ms to query the database and render SSR HTML.

steps.label: 2. Edge Flushes 103 Early Hints
steps.description: At t=15ms, the CDN sends an interim 103 frame with Link preload headers while origin SSR still runs.
steps.codeHighlight:
HTTP/2 103 Early Hints
Link: </app.css>; rel=preload; as=style

steps.label: 3. 200 OK HTML Arrives
steps.description: At t=350ms, the HTML arrives, but app.css is already in memory—cutting First Contentful Paint.
